rationale: Builds on the best reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact curriculum change: earlier recurrent tail blocks now start effectively off and ramp in quadratically from a new cold gain instead of contributing at the old nonzero floor from step 0. This keeps compile-stable shapes, preserves the proven export path, and tests a cleaner late-phase recurrence scheduling hypothesis after recent always-on tail variants regressed.
title: Cold-Start Tail Recurrence Curriculum
